hero.description: Hello, I'm {name}. I'm a full-stack developer with a background in Information Technology and Telecommunications. I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies and building useful digital solutions.

about.p1: My background combines formal education in Information Technology and Telecommunications with practical experience in web development.
about.p2: During my studies, I developed a foundation in programming, databases, computer systems and networking. These skills helped me understand how software and technology work together.
about.p3: Outside my professional experience, I enjoy exploring new technologies, continuously improving my technical skills, and working on projects that challenge me to think creatively. I am also passionate about classical music, particularly playing the clarinet and occasionally composing duets for clarinet and flute.
